src-tauri/src/storage/feeds/items.rs.note: RSS feed list ordering now intentionally sorts unread first, then COALESCE(published_at,fetched_at) DESC, fetched_at DESC, id DESC so same-published newly fetched items appear earlier. upsert_items prunes only old seen and unimported feed_items beyond FEED_ITEMS_KEEP_PER_FEED=1000; never prune unread or imported_paper_id rows.
